moods.mood_description: Rudra and Meher's first meeting at the club
The honor and future of two people from different social classes will be determined
Loneliness beneath Rudra's confidence, Meher's dilemma of self-respect
Rudra's wealth and glamour versus Meher's self-esteem
Silent discomfort in the clash of their perspectives
Rudra believes money is everything; Meher believes in the truth of love
Meher does not easily respond to Rudra's proposal
Both feel—breaking society's rules is not easy
A glimpse of their uncertain future relationship can be seen
Where the relationship begins, the end is exactly the opposite
